title: Exploring synergies between AIGC and TRIZ in the optimisation of road cone design through integrated innovation methods
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper investigates the integration of AIGC and TRIZ in traffic cone design, comparing their efficiency, innovation, and stakeholder acceptance through experiments and surveys.
exclusion_facts: The paper does not collect human subjective evaluations directly. It uses Likert scales and UTAUT2 model for analysis, but does not report actual human responses or subjective evaluations.
